card.name: "But" in "many, but not all"
card.fires_on: The word "but" right after "In many," or "Many," in the phrase "many, but not all" in warning text. Weaker on other contrast or list words such as "then" or a comma in a drug list.

modes.label: Many, but not all
modes.description: "But" after "many," in the phrase "many, but not all cases".
modes.example: In many,<< but>> not all of these cases, bup

modes.label: Other joining words
modes.description: A joining word or comma inside a sentence about drug interactions or incidence over time.
modes.example: The incidence of myopathy, including rhabdomyolysis, was highest during the first year and<< then>> notably decreased during the subsequent years of treatment
